text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, reliable roommate. You've got a 
cute visitor out in the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...? Thank you for letting me know, sir! I 
shall report immediately!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Is this in place of a calling card? 
Good grief... there's not even a letter, 
sir."
"CASE: Special Assignment"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss! Fenomeno, on site!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Apologies for the late hour. Thank you for 
letting me watch the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe here!!
choice_data_list: You brought Gold Ship along too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Upon checking the situation, Gold 
Ship-san had already submitted her night 
outing permit as well.
choice_data_list: ゴールドシップも連れてきたんだね

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...The paper explicitly states this 
trainer's office as her destination. If I 
didn't bring her here, she'd be classified 
as missing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Trainer, wanna eat a roof tile?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What do you take the Boss for?!
choice_data_list: Then I'll turn on the TV.

text_block_list.text:
Our viewing of the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe started off peacefully. However, 
that atmosphere—instantly changed.
choice_data_list: じゃあテレビをつけるよ

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In second place is Orfevre! Orfevre is 
moving up!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Still, Orfevre finishes in 2nd place once 
again!! What a truly... truly frustrating 
result!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—However, this frustration is proof of how 
much we believed in her strength! And we 
will continue to believe in her from here 
on out!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
If anyone can take on the world—it has to 
be her!!

Fenomeno and the others stare intently at 
the screen. And then—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Hahaha. Looks so yummy~. Can Golshi-chan 
eat it? Or will it swallow me up instead?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah... On such foreign turf, without even 
letting the difference in environment 
show... Trying to overpower them through 
sheer force to the very end—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"To wield that kind of power... She truly 
is—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Strong.

Despite the late hour, breaking news 
alerts related to the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe popped up on the smartphone one 
after another.

Why is every single move Orfevre makes 
reported in such detail? Why are people so 
captivated by Orfevre?

That is because Orfevre —is the strongest 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre-san! Excellent work on your second 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe! So, what's 
next—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It's the Arima.

text_block_list.name: @Race_Maniac
text_block_list.text:
"【Good News】 Orfevre to the Arima 
Kinen."

text_block_list.name: @nununu
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa~ Fenomeno and Gold Ship have no 
chance of getting 1st place now. Those two 
are pretty entertaining though~"

text_block_list.name: @Turf_Dweller
text_block_list.text:
"'Prediction: Golshi will mess around. 
Phenomeno-san, thanks for your hard 
work~'"

"‘Justice always wins, right? So what does 
it mean if Fenomeno loses?’"

"At the very least, the champion of 
justice we looked up to is gone."

"That tweet was awful, wasn't it? Turning 
on her all of a sudden like that. And here 
I thought they liked Fenomeno."

"If you had stayed a hero of justice until 
the very end, I could have cheered for 
you."

The internet was overflowing with all 
kinds of voices. People whose attitudes 
had softened since summer. People who had 
even begun attacking Fenomeno.
choice_data_list: ...I hope Meno isn't watching...

text_block_list.text:
When she started social media, I made her 
promise not to look at the comments, 
but... if her strong sense of 
responsibility kicks in—
choice_data_list: ……メノが見ていないか心配だな

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Fenomeno made villains out of us, so 
he'll lose. Because he's not an ally of 
justice," huh...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...That is not the case. I do not mean to 
reject you as a person. I just... want to 
stop your actions...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...I must win.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I will win. The justice I found will 
triumph, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose. I won't falter. If I lose 
like this... it means letting you take my 
future away.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—I don't want any of you to end up on the 
side of evil, robbing others of their 
future...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I will protect them. ...Both that child 
and all of you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That's why, even against someone as strong 
as Orfe-san—

Fenomeno's training for the day was set at 
a 14-14 pace. But when I clocked her 
time...
choice_data_list:
(13 seconds per furlong... That's clearly 
fast.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss, the next...! Your next 
orders............!
choice_data_list: （1ハロン13秒……明らかに速い）

text_block_list.text:
"Without even stopping to wipe off her 
sweat, Fenomeno presses on for the next 
thing. Is it impatience that drives her?"
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, got it. Next is yours, Meno.
...Yeah, got it. Next up, right, Meno?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I'm off today...? And tomorrow too...?
choice_data_list: ……ああ、わかった。次だね、メノ
……うん、わかった。次だね、メノ

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wha, why, Boss!? Every single day counts 
right now as we prepare for the Arima 
Kinen—!
choice_data_list: Why are you in such a hurry?
Why are you in such a rush?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That is... because I must not lose.
choice_data_list: どうしてそんなに焦っているんだ？
どうしてそんなに焦っているの？

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"As an ally of justice by my own decree! 
There are things I simply must do!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Justice never falters! We must not yield!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, that crying boy's future 
will...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I won't be able to protect that boy's 
future, or everyone else's! That's why 
I—!!"
choice_data_list: Meno, stop!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Stop?
choice_data_list: メノ、止まって

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
choice_data_list: 君に正義があるのは相手に屈しないため？
貴方に正義があるのは相手に屈しないため？

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes! That's why—
choice_data_list: 君は守るために、正義の味方になったんだ
貴方は守るために、正義の味方になったはず

text_block_list.text: (CLATTER-RATTLE!!)
choice_data_list: だから俺も、正義の味方になりたい
だから私も、正義の味方になりたい

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Golshi-san? Why are you here—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You're the ones who left it unlocked, 
ain'tcha? Cold-brewing kelp dashi takes 
time, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mame-chin. I'm running in the Arima Kinen 
too, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna beat Orfe first! You won't be 
doing a darn thing, na-na-na-boo-boo!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Hah. ...Wh-What? Y-You...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"And also, the zig-zag grass separators in 
bento boxes. I gotta prepare for the 
contest to make those, too."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Shall we make some sushi?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Um, Golshi-san. Are you—
choice_data_list: Even Gold Ship is your ally of justice!
Even Gold Ship is your ally of justice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: ゴールドシップだって君の正義の味方だ
ゴールドシップだって貴方の正義の味方だ

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You... still wanna make the lights 
here even brighter?
choice_data_list: 今だって、君の未来を明るくしたがってる
今だって、貴方の未来を明るくしたがってる

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
choice_data_list: 出てくれるんだろ、『有馬記念』に
出てくれるんでしょ、『有馬記念』に

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "...―― ...Golshi-san."
choice_data_list: 君と張り合えば、メノは強くなれるから
貴方と張り合えば、メノは強くなれるから

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah. I was in the middle of a game of 
Gomoku. See ya~

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
choice_data_list: —Fenomeno.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: ――フェノーメノ

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: 君はいろんなウマ娘と出会い、成長した
貴方はいろんなウマ娘と出会い、成長した

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have found my justice... something 
the old me could never find.
choice_data_list: 君はちゃんと君の正義を見つけられた
貴方はちゃんと貴方の正義を見つけられた

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Meeting Gold Ship-san, Gentildonna-san, 
and everyone else... allowed me to find 
it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I will become strong. I've grown 
stronger, step by step."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Together with the heroes of justice who 
protected my future.
choice_data_list:
Don't worry, you're going to get even 
stronger.

It's okay, you're going to get even 
stronger

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: 大丈夫、君はさらに強くなるよ
大丈夫、貴方はさらに強くなるよ

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
choice_data_list: 君の正義は、みんなを守れる
貴方の正義は、みんなを守れる

text_block_list.text:
And when we stepped into the hallway so I 
could walk Fenomeno back... she stopped in 
her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Boss. There is a post I wish to make, 
as my final one.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: May I borrow your terminal?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Thank you.
choice_data_list: ……うん

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text: "I will win."

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text: "‘To protect everyone.’"

text_block_list.name: @Fenomeno_O
text_block_list.text: "With the Allies of Justice"
